ItemID: 3; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my setup, but I would choose the Echo Show's screen over another voice-only device this time.

ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Alexa display is relevant, but I would pick the larger Echo Show 8 for easier viewing.

ItemID: 8; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Adding a doorbell and more camera coverage fits my existing Blink interest, though I would check compatibility with my XT2 setup.
ItemID: 9; Title: WYZE Cam v2 - White; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Another security camera interests me, but I would prioritize expanding my Blink setup before adding another camera app.
